author_postflight.review_scope: full-resolution visual rejection only; not an independent approval
passing_observations: Both adult models are present in front/front-three-quarter LH-003 construction.

White mesh, black waistband without exterior drawstring, repeated rose/cloud field, black pocket welts, asymmetric black side panels, and red-white-black hem treatment remain visually close to the physical front.
The protected enchanted rose is sharp under glass in the approved cracked chamber.
Both wearers share a coherent floor, light field, contact shadow direction, reflection field, scale, and atmospheric depth.
reject_findings: The visible red side script resolves only as a partial Lo-like fragment on both shorts, not the required complete readable Love Hurts treatment.
Because logo and lettering accuracy is a 100-point gate and this is a declared hard reject, the otherwise strong scene cannot pass product fidelity or enter founder promotion.
